summary: Flush every balance-history column family before snapshot handoff and clean shutdown
details: Replace the default-column-family-only flush with a synchronous flush of default and all balance-history column families.
Prevent explicit full flushes from leaving import WAL pinned by unflushed metadata and data memtables, which delayed the first service open before RPC could listen.
Log the start of a full flush and test persistence without WAL replay in both normal and bulk import modes.
operator_actions: Include this fix in the next usdb-services image; replacing host scripts alone does not update the database implementation.
Let an already-running RocksDB recovery finish and inspect its LOG for progress. Existing snapshots and node data remain reusable.
